learner: Use E17's persistent student, context-conditioned replay, Adam-shaped update and exact world generator. No procedure controller or meta-training. All four cells receive the same observations and replay budget. Width changes only the two hidden layer sizes; the input remains 26 dimensions and output remains two.
context_intervention: The real candidate infers its 18-component context from preceding observed cross-moments, unchanged from E17. The explicitly privileged diagnostic receives the actual hidden regime index before prediction, encoded one-hot in the first four components of the same 18-component context interface. Its replay stores that code with each example. No oracle label reaches inferred arms. The encoding itself changes along with available information, so a gain is not attributed solely to an information-theoretic identification bound.
capacity_intervention: Compare hidden widths 16 and 64 under both context modes. Wider students have more weights and arithmetic; this is a relief-of-constraint diagnostic, not an equal-resource architecture win. The same fixed learning rate is used; results do not optimize the wide model's training procedure.
evaluation: Four fresh worlds per family, 4,096 batches each, all prequential predictions before outcomes. Report clean/noisy whole-stream and quarter MSE, first/final-four-batch segment errors and censored recovery under E17's frozen criterion. Boundaries and clean targets are recorder-only except the clearly labeled oracle regime input. Student, optimizer, replay and inferred context never reset at boundaries.
preflight: Require the inferred width-16 path to reproduce the unchanged E17 student exactly on dummy data; verify oracle codes and stored replay codes are valid one-hot vectors; verify fixed input/output shapes across widths, capacity counts, no hidden-state access in inferred input construction, paired observations, bounded replay and global step continuity.
costs: Record actual wall time, student forwards/gradient batches, weights, moments, replay/context/RNG tensor bytes and final checkpoints. Equal forward-example counts do not imply equal FLOPs for widths 16 and 64. No complete process RAM or energy measurement; CPU work may overlap E19. Diagnostic oracle access must never be advertised as autonomous inference.
falsification: If privileged context helps little but width helps, context identification alone does not explain the current failure. If privileged context helps while width under inferred context does little, identification/encoding is a stronger limit than raw capacity in this assay. If both help, the limits interact. Persistent residual failure even with oracle context and width means further learning/interference limits remain; the diagnostic does not promise a solution.
scope: A causal resource/information diagnostic, not a new deployed architecture. These finite fully supervised streams do not establish semantic memory compression, general reasoning, autonomous long-horizon control or novel recursive improvement. The full goal remains unachieved.
